shape.description: Long flat tray, open on top: a flat floor with two long slots and LOW straight side walls (about a third of a slot), lying on the floor plates' cell frames between two blocks 3 cells apart (centre to centre). At each end the floor sweeps steeply up into a short U-channel lip, like a track tongue, whose floor sits at the block's cup seat: the lip rests ON TOP of the block's cup end, overlapping it by about 9 mm, and two small hooks drop beside the block's tab loop. Nothing at the end goes down into the block's footprint. A marble rolls out of the block over the lip, down the end ramp and stops on the floor. No exit. T-Rex tan and Launchpad yellow are the same mould.

physics.behaviour: End piece. A marble rolls out of the block the tray hangs on, over the end notch, drops to the flat floor and stops. Marbles collect here. Both ends hook onto blocks the same way and both are inlets; nothing leaves. In paths above, to means where the marble settles, not an exit.

The Launchpad Level 3 plan never uses M-07; its count comes from the manual's label page, not the plan parts boxes.
